title: Polynomial-size layered circuit characterization
statement: A Boolean language $L$ is recognized by a polynomial-size family of layered circuits using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates if and only if there is such a family whose circuit sizes are bounded by a polynomial in the input length and whose recognized language is exactly $L$.
